label: CA-PIPEDA-2000 Section 13

obligations.text: Contents 13 (1) The Commissioner shall, within one year after the day on which a complaint is filed or is initiated by the Commissioner, prepare a report that contains (a) the Commissioner’s findings and recommendations;
(2) [Repealed, 2010, c. 23, s. 84] Report to parties (3) The report shall be sent to the complainant and the organization without delay. 2000, c. 5, s. 13; 2010, c. 23, s. 84
